sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE X OF 1979
ORDINANCE X OF 1979
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE 1979
An Ordinance further to
amend the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 9th February 1979]
No. F. 17 (1)79‑Pub.‑The following
Ordinance made by the President on the 9th February 1979 is hereby published
for general information :‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment)
Ordinance, 1979.
(2) It shall come into force on the twelfth day of
Rabi‑ul‑Awwal, 1399 Hijri, that is, the tenth day of February 1979.
